regime_context: The detector shows a textbook one-narrative regime: Banks (cn_banks) hold the sole eligible leadership position with the highest durability bar (0.83, trend, full breadth, crowded), and Coal is the only other eligible theme but is marked mean-revert. Critically, gate_helps is false on China A-shares history — the trend discipline did not reduce drawdown here, so the only validated edge is absent in this market; everything below is display-level structure, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's breadth (currently 0.5) expands above ~0.7 while its hurst_tag flips from 'mean-revert' to 'trend' — that combination would retire the watch by suggesting a confirmed challenger handoff rather than a coincident second-place ranking.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole eligible theme with the strongest durability profile (0.83 bar, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 1.0) and lead the rotation radar cleanly (margin 0.04 over Coal). This is a trend-following lean, not a return forecast: the rank names where leadership concentration sits, and the internal cohesion (full breadth) argues the trend is intact rather than a narrow spike. Crowding (z 1.85, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only — one-narrative dominance with high absorption means fading is the documented failure mode, so I lean WITH the leader but express this at low conviction because gate_helps is false (A-shares mean-reverts and whipsaws the trend gate).
theses.dissent: The same mean-reverting tape that makes gate_helps false could unwind a crowded, one-narrative leader violently; leadership is already fully absorbed (one_narrative=true, breadth 1.0), leaving little marginal buyer, and crowding at the top of an A-share Theme rotation has historically marked local exhaustion.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) underperforms the CSI 300 by more than 5% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme, but its own detector tags undercut it: hurst_tag 'mean-revert', breadth only 0.5, and a durability bar of 0.55 that is well below Banks' 0.83. In a narrow rotation (only 2 of 22 eligible, frac 0.09), the challenger is not confirmed as a handoff — it is merely second by rank while displaying mean-reverting texture. Leaning away from Coal is the inverse of the Banks lean under the same low-conviction, gate-disabled regime.
theses.dissent: Coal is a classic mean-revert name in a market whose backtest says the trend gate whipsaws — a sharp cyclical/policy catalyst (e.g. coal price or power demand surprise) could snap it higher precisely because momentum-readers are positioned for mean reversion, and its score is still within 0.04 of the leader.
